PROSE.rule: Old Prose routes are stale and non-dispatchable. Any genuinely open integration result is an ordinary BOOK obligation.

PROGRAMMING.rule: Programming engineering/product work is not dispatchable as peer work before explicit admission.

owner_discovery_rule: Controllers enumerate owner_files as active lanes and compare its keys against CURRENT-AUTHORITY topology peer_system_ids on every run. Sets must match exactly. Missing coverage never creates a new system and retired systems are never provisioned.
job_lock_rule: Before dispatch every delegation must conform to current topology, program job lock and completion status. Cross-lane work, retired-system resurrection, unauthorized user side effects or false completion must not dispatch.
system_lane_rule: The active peer worker lanes are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE. PROSE is terminally retired. Programming remains a named non-peer work program until explicit admission.
portfolio_rule: The controller reads CURRENT-AUTHORITY, selected topology, job lock, completion status, current obligation registry, repair state, every owner file and live owner control before dispatch.
night_start_rule: Freshly re-read CURRENT-AUTHORITY, selected topology, job lock, completion status, obligation registry, repair state and owner control bindings before execution; never trust stale snapshots.
dispatch_rule: Dispatch only job-conforming READY/CANDIDATE work in active peer lanes. User-authorized external actions remain subject to explicit action authority.
claim_rule: Only one mutation-capable claim/lease may be live per active owner lane. PROSE has no claim domain. Programming has no peer claim domain before topology admission.
retry_rule: Transient dependencies receive finite classified retries; after exhaustion select independent safe work within the same owner job.
stale_rule: No job survives a live-head, current-obligation, job-lock, topology, completion-status or retired-system mismatch.
no_work_rule: An active peer lane may be idle only after durable all-eight-rungs exhaustion for its own locked job. Retired systems require no lane or exhaustion proof.
successor_rule: After completion/material block, re-read live authority and select the next dependency-valid successor inside the same active lane job. Never bind a Prose successor.
utilization_rule: Active peer ledgers are exactly the eight owner_files lanes. Book-owned preserved-Prose integration is BOOK telemetry only. Programming product work has no peer utilization ledger before admission.
